messages.text: Any update on my return label for my NerdAxeQ++ 6th?
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
I can check that for you. What's the email on the order, and the order number if you have it handy?
(email hidden)
Ran returns.py (store-orders skill)
Used the store-orders skill
Looked something up in Shopify

Thanks. I'm looking at the NerdQaxe++ 6 TH on order Shop····, delivered July 9. There's no return label open on it yet, and nothing has come back to us, so nothing is in flight on our side.

Tell me what the unit is doing and I'll get it moving. Is it faulty, and if so what are you seeing, and has it ever been overclocked?
I fill out a form RMA last week when my miner decided to throw sparks
Used route to tech
I'll let our technical specialist pick this up.
I fill out a form RMA last week when my miner decided to throw sparks

Back with you on the order side. Hal's confirmed it as a board fault, and your RMA from last week is with the team for approval now. They'll confirm the return by email shortly, and once it's approved I'll have your prepaid label and the return reference right here in this chat.

Sorry you've had to chase this after a sparking unit. Keep it unplugged until then.
It’s been unplug since it happened

Good, that's exactly right. Leave it that way and don't box it up yet either.

Nothing else needed from you right now. The team is reviewing the return and will confirm shortly, and the label and return reference come to you here as soon as it's approved.
About how long does it take?

The approval is with the team right now, and they're on until 6pm Eastern today, so I'd expect word quickly rather than days. I won't put a firm clock on it beyond that.

Once your unit reaches our warehouse, processing takes up to 10 days from arrival. Watch your inbox for the approval, and I'll post the label here too.
I put in the rma form last week

You did, and a week with no reply on a unit that threw sparks isn't good enough. I'm sorry.

Let me put it in front of them directly so it isn't sitting in a queue.
Handed to the team · RMA approval needs JD or Georges; form submitted a week ago with no response.
That's with JD and Georges now. Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in here. If you step away, the approval and your label come to your email instead.
Jd saw the picture of my unit on discord

That helps, thanks. JD's already seen the board, so the approval should be quick, and he's tagged on this chat now.

Nothing more for you to do. The moment it's approved I'll post your prepaid label and the return reference right here.
Do you email?

Yes. The approval and the label go to (email hidden), and a copy of this whole conversation comes to you by email once we're done here.

Our mail has been landing in junk for some people, so add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts. If you'd rather it go to a different address, tell me which one.
Mean
Sorry, not sure I caught that. Did you mean the email address, or something else?
Yes

Got it, so we'll use (email hidden) That's the address on the order, so the approval, the label and the transcript all go there.

If you want it sent somewhere else instead, just type the address and I'll note it.
The email on file is just fine

Perfect, we'll keep it there.

Nothing else needed from you. JD and Georges have the RMA, and the approval plus your prepaid label land in that inbox, and here in the chat too. Keep the unit unplugged until the label arrives.
Thank you

You're welcome, and sorry again for the week of silence on it.

One thing while you're here, you've got a few units with us now. What are you running them all on, one circuit at home or spread out?
Spread out

Good, that's the safer way to run them.

One more and I'll leave you be: you've picked up a mix, the DC06s, the NerdOctaxe, the H15 Dual. Are you chasing the Dogecoin and Litecoin side now, or just spreading across coins to see what sticks?
I think mining is like a investment and you need to spread out and not keep your eggs in one basket

That's a sound way to look at it, and it's how a lot of our steadier customers buy.

I'll leave the RMA with JD and Georges. Watch that inbox, your approval and label come through there and here. Thanks for being patient with us on it.
Thank you
Anytime. Keep it unplugged, and if anything else comes up before the label lands, just write here.
